resources.string:
1. Stop the regular app and other silencing apps.
2. Close the camera and start a test.
3. Open your camera, take one photo, then return here to report the sound.
The test stops after 3 minutes.

Only this test is recorded (up to 200 events). Device model, OS, camera app and audio API states are included. The latest report stays on this device until replaced or deleted. Review it before copying or sharing. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
